name: Hit
description: A weapon landing on chitin. A short square thump falling an octave, over a scatter of dry grains that dulls as it goes — the shell giving a little, not air moving. Every enemy takes hundreds of these in a run, so it is deliberately the smallest sound in the set.

elite.description: The same strike on something armoured: everything drops well below the ordinary hit and takes half again as long to give, so an elite reads as heavier without a second sound being authored.
